title: Fix Broken Test Collection
body: The test suite fails to collect due to `ModuleNotFoundError` and `NameError`. `pytest --collect-only` reports errors in multiple files. Fix imports and paths.

title: Remove False Green CI Configuration
body: The CI pipeline (`ci-standard.yml`) uses `|| echo` or `|| true` to mask failures in Black, Mypy, and Pytest. Remove these bypasses to ensure build failures reflect code quality.

title: Refactor Data_Processor_r0.py
body: The file `src/data_processing/data_processor/python/data_processor/Data_Processor_r0.py` is a monolithic script (300KB+). Refactor it into a modular package structure.

title: Migrate from Print to Logging
body: Over 400 `print()` statements were found in the codebase. Migrate them to use the `logging` module as per `AGENTS.md`.

title: Standardize Directory Structure
body: Merge the `tools/` directory into `src/` to unify the codebase structure and eliminate legacy/modern confusion.

title: Enable Linting for Legacy Code
body: Remove exclusions in `ruff.toml` for `data_processing` and `legacy` directories. Fix the resulting lint errors.
